# Atsuita karaori (Noh Costume)

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Atsuita karaori (Noh Costume)
- **Artist / Maker:** Japan
- **Date:** late Edo period (1789–1868), 1801/25
- **Style / Period:** late edo
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 796

- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/2c7b5171-f708-0832-bb41-03f4c8f06b3d/full/400,/0/default.jpg
